name: personal-assistant
description: A local personal assistant that turns Markdown, screenshots, and Google Calendar into three achievable daily actions.

interface.shortDescription: Three achievable actions, informed by your life.
interface.longDescription: Plan your day from local to-do files, phone screenshots, and Google Calendar. Keep editable context through conversation and manage only assistant-owned calendar blocks. Requires Windows and a connected Google Calendar plugin.
defaultPrompt: Plan the rest of my day.
Update my task progress and context.
